Subject: Onboarding docs & preferred invoice fields for Redwood purchase order

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're finalising our setup for Redwood and would like to make sure invoices and tax evidence land in the correct place to avoid delays on PO-98211. Quick questions:

- Which invoice fields do you require on EU invoices so the AP team can process without manual rework? (e.g., VAT number placement, PO reference format, breakdown of VAT amount)
- Do you support reverse-charge invoices (no VAT charged) with your PO? If yes, which reference should we include?
- Any specific file naming conventions for attachments in your procurement portal?

I attached our NL VAT certificate and a sample invoice so you can confirm.

Attachments: NL-VAT-certificate.pdf (stub, 92KB), sample-invoice-20261109.pdf (stub, 38KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Jansen <sofie.jansen@astralogistics.nl>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs & preferred invoice fields for Redwood purchase order

Hi Sofie — thanks for sending these over and for the sample invoice. We're close to activating the vendor record but need a couple of clarifications to avoid PO hold-ups on the first invoice: 

1) Required invoice fields for AP (what to include exactly):
   - Invoice number (obvious)
   - Invoice date
   - PO reference: please include PO-98211 exactly in the \"Reference / Order\" field; that maps to our PO ingestion rules.
   - Redwood billing address (please bill to: Redwood Inference, 2200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114) — we also accept our EU billing node, but PO-98211 was created under our EU legal entity so include EU billing entity if possible.
   - VAT registration number (format: country code + number; e.g., NL123456789B01) — place this near the top of the invoice.
   - Line-level VAT amount and VAT rate per line (we use these to validate reverse-charge vs standard VAT).

2) Reverse charge flow:
   - We do accept reverse-charge (no VAT) when applicable. On reverse-charge invoices please add the text: \"Reverse charge — Article 196 (EU VAT Directive) applies\" and include your VAT number + our EU VAT (REDFR-GB123456) in the header so our tax team can match.

3) File naming / attachment guidance:
   - Preferred: <vendor>-<invoice#>-<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (e.g., astra-INV-20261109-20261109.pdf)
   - If sending the VAT certificate include it as VAT-cert-<country>-<vendor>.pdf

Laura / Vivek — can you confirm any additional PO field mapping that AP needs (tax codes, GL mapping) before I send this back to Astra?

Best,
Lukas
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Sofie Jansen <sofie.jansen@astralogistics.nl>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs & preferred invoice fields for Redwood purchase order

Thanks, Lukas. A couple of procurement/finance add-ons: 

- Tax code mapping: please include one line per PO item with a short description and net amount. We require the VAT amount and rate per line. Our AP system (Coupa-backed ingestion) expects the tax fields to be present otherwise the invoice routes to manual review.
- GL/accounting: we'll set the default GL to 5.10.200 (Third-party services) for this vendor. If you have different line items (hardware vs services) call them out on the invoice and we will map accordingly.
- Country-specific: for NL suppliers we need the VAT number and a scanned VAT certificate (good). If the vendor is registered for reverse charge, include the statutory reference as Lukas noted and the invoice must show VAT = 0 with a clear reverse-charge note.

Small ask for Lukas: when you upload the vendor record into our SSO onboarding portal, please set the 'PO-required' flag to true and copy the PO reference format (PO-98211). That prevents local teams from accepting non-PO invoices.

Sofie: once you send the final invoice with the PO reference please also attach the VAT cert as a second file. We'll trigger validation and confirm within 24 hours.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
